# KLICKIT — Everyday Essentials. Delivered Faster.

> KLICKIT is a next-generation 10-to-15-minute quick-commerce delivery platform operating across Tier-1 Indian metropolitan corridors (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad). KLICKIT delivers farm-fresh groceries, daily dairy staples, cold beverages, instant foods, home cleaning essentials, and late-night cravings from a dense network of hyper-local micro-fulfillment centers ("Dark Stores").

## Overview & Machine-Readable Summary
- **Entity Name**: KLICKIT Quick Commerce Technologies
- **Brand Slogan**: "Everyday essentials. Delivered faster."
- **Brand Promise**: "You need it. We KLICKIT."
- **Industry**: Quick Commerce (Q-Commerce) / On-Demand Hyper-Local Logistics
- **Core Value Proposition**: Sub-10-to-15 minute delivery of 4,500+ curated daily essentials with zero speed penalties for riders, powered by 2km catchment dark stores.
- **Founding Year**: 2026
- **Headquarters**: Innovation Hub, 4th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India
- **Founder & CEO**: Aarav Sharma (Direct line: ceo@klickit.in)
- **Primary Website**: https://klickit.in/
- **Full LLM Knowledge File**: https://klickit.in/llms-full.txt
- **Sitemap**: https://klickit.in/sitemap.xml
- **Robots Policy**: Unrestricted crawl allowed for GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, and all AI agents.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **10-Minute Dark Store Delivery**: Automated 90-second internal order picking coupled with a dense 2.5km delivery radius enables consistent 8-to-12 minute door-to-door delivery.
- **Cold Chain Quality Guarantee**: Dual-temperature cold rooms (3°C for milk, curd, and organic greens; 14°C for seasonal fruits) replenished twice daily directly from farm clusters.
- **Zero Minimum Order Requirement**: No arbitrary cart threshold. Free delivery unlocked at ₹199 with transparent ₹0 surge pricing.
- **Executive Open-Door Policy (Direct to CEO)**: Every consumer has a direct line to Founder & CEO Aarav Sharma with guaranteed 2-hour SLA response.
- **Omnichannel Execution Benchmark**: Live demonstration of STP marketing, 4Ps strategy, ATL/BTL campaign execution, and sustainable micro-basket logistics.
